title: Product singular no-cache root-cause checkpoint

excluded_culprits: WooCommerce core product cache helper only forces no-cache on cart/checkout/account
active K20 custom snippets do not set product/comment no-cache
custom Keshavarz plugins do not expose a generic comments-open no-cache rule
verified.unresolved_owner: Likely protected renderer/runtime path; IranKala comments.php is ionCube-protected, so textual source inspection cannot verify its internal behavior.

next_safe_test.action: Enable LiteSpeed Cache > Cache > ESI > Enable ESI only; leave Cache Comment Form enabled and all other settings unchanged.
next_safe_test.reason: admin_settings is hard-blocked by keshavarz20-git-ops, so the assistant must not toggle ESI indirectly.
acceptance_after_user_action: Open-comments product transitions from explicit no-cache to cacheable HIT for anonymous visitor
Product review/comment form remains present and usable
Cart, checkout and account remain non-cacheable/session-safe
No logged-in/private content leaks into public cache
next_safe_test.rollback: If acceptance fails, user switches Enable ESI back OFF immediately.

no_repeat: Do not rerun comments-open/closed A/B before the ESI setting changes.
